name: 365-day recency weights
config: C0 LightGBM; sample_weight=2^(-age_days/365), normalized mean 1

name: 24-month rolling training window
config: C0 LightGBM; train only sales in the preceding 24 calendar months

name: Cyclical listing month and quarter
config: C0 LightGBM; add listing-month sine/cosine and quarter

name: Log area and range uncertainty
config: C0 LightGBM; add log area, range flag, width, and relative width

name: Area, room, parking interactions
config: C0 LightGBM; add area/bedrooms, washrooms/bedrooms, parking/area, and type-by-log-area

name: Native property-type category
config: C0 LightGBM; replace six type indicators with house_type_name category

name: Synthetic coordinate grid
config: C0 LightGBM; 0.02-degree training-origin grid and type-by-grid category

name: As-of community/type price-per-area prior
config: C0 LightGBM; strict-before-listing community/type and municipality/type log-price-per-area means; pseudocount 50

name: As-of 90/365-day type momentum
config: C0 LightGBM; strict-before-listing same-type trailing-window means and counts

name: Past OOF local residual adjustment
config: Nearest 30 same-type OOF residuals within 365 days; IQR-scaled coordinates; shrink n/(n+50)

name: Huber robust loss
config: C0 LightGBM target; objective=huber, alpha=0.9; assert actual objective after fit

name: Log price per square foot target
config: C0 LightGBM; log(sold_price/area), invert with prediction-time area

name: Direct-dollar MAPE objective
config: LightGBM objective=mape on positive dollar sold_price; reject nonpositive output

name: Past OOF global multiplier calibration
config: Median past OOF sold/pred factor clipped to [0.95,1.05]

name: Past OOF property-type shrinkage calibration
config: Type factors shrink to global factor with pseudocount 200; require 100 observations

name: Spline hedonic Ridge
config: Five-knot cubic splines, sparse one-hot categories, linear time, Ridge alpha=10 solver=lsqr

name: ExtraTrees
config: 200 trees, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=0.8, seed 0, four threads

name: XGBoost histogram with native categories
config: 600 trees, depth 6, learning_rate .05, min_child_weight 5, lambda 3, hist, native category, JSON model

name: CatBoost ordered list-price ratio
config: 600 iterations, depth 6, learning_rate .05, l2=3, ratio target, has_time=true

name: Fixed 50/50 complementary-family blend
config: Blend C0 with the best completed different-family challenger at fixed 0.5 weight in price space
